name: Khan Dez'hepah
summary: After The Kolkar of Desolace, Felgur Twocuts turns against Khan Dez'hepah. Many centaur clans fight across Desolace, and Felgur wants the Kolkar weakened before they unite.

sections.title: Divided Clans
sections.body: Across Desolace, centaur clans fight one another. The Kolkar are one of many, roaming the dry plains and killing their own. Felgur Twocuts does not mourn their losses. Centaur are strong and brutal, and united they would be a fierce foe for the Horde. Felgur wants the Kolkar weakened before that can happen.

sections.title: The Kolkar Leader
sections.body: Felgur Twocuts begins by disrupting the Kolkar. Their village lies northeast of where Felgur stands. Felgur wants Khan Dez'hepah's head brought back.

faq.q: Why does Felgur Twocuts want Khan Dez'hepah dead?
faq.answer: Felgur Twocuts fears the centaur clans may unite against the Horde. Felgur means to disrupt the Kolkar first by killing Khan Dez'hepah.
Khan Dez'hepah is in the Kolkar Village, northeast of Felgur Twocuts in Desolace.

faq.q: What does Felgur want brought back?
faq.answer: Felgur Twocuts wants Khan Dez'hepah's head brought back.
The Kolkar of Desolace comes first. Afterward, Felgur Twocuts sends you against the Kolkar leader, Khan Dez'hepah.
